description: Land Acquisition - Kanameewala Village, Alawwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the state for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their names, uses, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
